verdict.rationale: Orrick's own pages publish a named startup program, Tech Studio, with one stated term: free self-service forms and generators, no registration required. A separate equity-compensation offering is described as 'fixed-fee basis', but it is not startup-specific and lists no prices. Neither amounts to a published fee package for startup legal services. Missing for 10: deferred-fee arrangement, fixed-fee formation offering with stated prices, a named startup legal-services program with published fee terms, independent corroboration of any such terms.
